ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the distance from point $M$, the midpoint of one side of rhombus $ABCD$, to point $O$, the intersection of the diagonals, is $5\text{cm}$. What is the perimeter of rhombus $ABCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus,\\
it follows that $\angle$AOB=$90^\circ$,\\
since M is the midpoint of side AB,\\
it follows that AB=2OM=10,\\
thus, the perimeter of the rhombus ABCD is $10\times 4=\boxed{40}$.
